name: gravity-autopilot
description: Free, open-source auto-accept for Antigravity: native commands + CDP button clicking, command blocklist/allowlist, optional Swarm mode. No license key, no telemetry.

commands.title: Gravity Autopilot: Show Launch Setup (CDP port)

gravityAutopilot.cdpPort.description: Remote-debugging port Antigravity was launched with (--remote-debugging-port).

gravityAutopilot.pollIntervalMs.description: How often native accept commands are fired.

gravityAutopilot.autoAcceptFileEdits.description: Auto-accept file edits. Turn off to review diffs yourself.

gravityAutopilot.autoRetry.description: Click Retry / Continue when the agent errors or hits a step limit.

gravityAutopilot.extraButtonTexts.description: Extra button labels to click (e.g. translations: 'toujours autoriser').

gravityAutopilot.blockedCommands.description: Terminal commands containing any of these (case-insensitive) are NEVER auto-run. Blocklist beats allowlist.

gravityAutopilot.allowedCommands.description: If non-empty, ONLY commands containing one of these are auto-run.

gravityAutopilot.swarm.enabled.description: Best-effort: when you are idle, open other Agent Manager conversations that are waiting for approval so they get unblocked.

gravityAutopilot.swarm.idleSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity before Swarm may switch conversations (prevents stealing focus while you type).
